step5_question.question: Using Procter & Gamble's Form 10-K for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2026, what was P&G's return on capital employed (ROCE) for fiscal 2026, and how does it compare with fiscal 2025? Define ROCE = operating income / capital employed, where capital employed = total assets - total current liabilities at fiscal year-end. Report both as percentages rounded to one decimal place and state whether ROCE increased or decreased.
